title: CRLR/262/2012 of DR. SUNIL KRISHNA NEGI Vs SMT. SAPNA NEGI

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
Criminal Revision No. 262 of 2012
Dr. Sunil Krishna Negi ............ Revisionist
versus
Smt. Sapna Negi .......... Respondent
Mr. D.S.Mehta, Advocate, present for the revisionist.
Mr. Raman Kumar Shah, Advocate, present for the respondent.
U.C. Dhyani, J. (Oral)
1. Ms. Sapna Negi (wife), duly identified by her counsel Raman
Kumar Shah, Advocate and Sunil Krishna Negi (husband),
duly identified by his counsel D.S.Mehta, Advocate, are
present in the Court. They appeared before the Mediation
Centre of this Court today itself. According to the terms of
settlement, the parties have agreed to jointly file a Divorce
Petition under Section 13-B IPC of the Hindu Marriage Act,
before the Family Court, Nainital on 15th May, 2013. The
parties have also agreed that the husband Dr. Sunil Krishna
Negi will pay a lump sum of Rs. 15 lacs including all claims
and stridhan of the permanent alimony to Ms. Sapna Negi.
Fifty per cent of the aforesaid amount will be paid on the date
of filing of Divorce Petition by way of Demand Draft. The
balance fifty per cent will be paid at the time of disposal of
joint Divorce Petition. The parties have also agreed that all
pending cases between them will be disposed of in terms of
settlement arrived at by way of mediation.

2
2. Criminal Revision preferred on behalf of revisionist against
the respondent is thus disposed of in terms of compromise
entered into between the parties before the Mediation Centre
of this Court today.
3. The compromise shall form part of this Order. Impugned order
is set aside in terms of the compromise.
i.
 (U.C. Dhyani, J.)
 16.04.2013
Kaushal
